book.name: Aposel
book.title: Yesu nusi erungwa ongwa yal kobe, Aposel, ka main konagi erungwa

content: Ananayas ebin Sapaira kal erungwa main
Tomba yal ta kaan Ananayas milere ebinbi kaan Sapaira milungwa. Yalini gariba taw ibal tere kobile moni ingwa.
Tobe taw yalini aal kule nongure ebinbi para kanungure, tobe imo dungwa nusi erungwa ongwa yal kobe, Aposel, tongwa.
Tongure Pita di yalini tongwa, “Ananayas, gariba tobe taw i inin aal kule nenga, God Kegemama Iban kakiibi di tenwa. Satan i kiranin sire ka dungwa, tameran i pire wiina erine?
Gariba goma tobe ikinga kaun i gariba dungwi. Tobe inga, i kobile moni kobaan milingi. Iru eringa, tameran nomanin suna ali si pire erine? I kakiibi di ibal kobe tenba, kakiibi di God para tenwa.”
Ka dungwa i Ananayas pirere gin taran yaa paire gulungwa. Gulungure ibal kobe pirere para kuril pirungwa.
Yal garamil urere yobilagi daw sire ire malge pire maul si yongwa.
Kaun tawliga wei sungure winbi gulungwa pirekire ebinbi ala ungwa.
Ungure Pita sirin bile abalini tongwa, “Gariba tobe iru ino?” Dungure abalini maan dire iru dungwa, “Owa, tobe iru ibinwa.”
Dungure Pita di abalini tongwa, “I te wininbi bole God Singaba Iban bawle terala dire, tameran iru erine? Yal kobe i wininbi maul si yongwa, kaya u kana giran milere i para ire malge namua.”
Dungure abalini gin taran Pita kawn mina yaa paire gulungwa. Yal garamil kobe urere gulungwa kanere ire malge pire, winbi yongwa binan kole ebinbi maul si yongwa.
Ka main ibal taminin para te ibal para, kal iru erungwa i, ka di ungwa pirere kuril wen pirungwa.
Kal guman kwi dungwa main main i maribe erungwa

Nusi erungwa ongwa yal kobe, Aposel, kal guman kwi dungwa binanbile erere, kalkan erungure ibal buul kunungwa para binanbile erungwa. Pire gi dungwa ibal para, kuul ale kaan Solomon Ai u ku bile milungwa.
Milungure ibal taw mena milungwa bole pena galekenamba, ibal para wai pire yalin kobe tongwa.
Ibal binanbile yal te abal para Yesu Singaba pire gi di tongure, Yesu ka main ibal taminin u bil ongwa.

Nusi erungwa ongwa yal kobe, Aposel, konagi iru ere milungwa ena ibal kobe nibil erungwa ibal awli kombil pire, duul kaal pire ye tere iru nomanin si pirungwa, “Nibil ere milungwa ibal taw, Pita guun si muulangwa, u pilaan painamua.”
Ibal Yerusalem ogu ai bil maala ki paingwa, ogin pisere nibil erungwa ibal te sia den miriin suna milungwa ibal, awli Yerusalem ungire para u wai ongwa.
Aposel kobe kanin paangure, angel ure awli mena erungwa
Ena Yuda ka main kenin erungwa yal bil te yalini gawlima kobe Sadusi ibal milungwa, para san bale nusi erungwa ongwa yal kobe, Aposel tere
kanin sungure kanin paingwa ogu ali awli ongwa.
Omba gilaa iray angel ta urere kanin paingwa ogu kana giran yawlere, nusi erungwa ongwa yal kobe, Aposel awli mena pirere iru di tongwa,
“I pi Yuda ka main ogu bil ala mile, ibal kol kwi pire mile painangwal painangwa main di gawa dire bolin kule to.”

Dungure are nol erungware pi Yuda ka main ogu bil ala pire ka nil si tongwa. Yuda ka main kenin erungwa yal bil te gawlima kobe, “U ku bilo,” di Isirel singaba para tongure, urere yal kobe kanin paingwa ogu nusi ere iru di tongwa, “Yal kobe awli wo.”
Dungure simil nen kobe kanin paingwa ogu u bawa dire, yal kobe milekungwa kanere kwi urere bolin kule tere dungwa,
“Kanin paingwa kana giran yaale gi dire, el kwi nu milungwa yal kobe binan kole milungwa kanebinba, yawlebinga ibal ala ta milekemua.”
Ka main ogu simil nen bil ta, te kenin erungwa yal bil kobe ka dungwa i pirere, nomanin si gogo erere iru pirungwa, “Iru erungwa we, takal erame?”
Ena yal ta ure iru di tongwa, “Yal kobe i kanin paingwa yal iray, ka main ogu bil ala mile ka nil si ibal kobe tomua.”
Dungure ka main ogu simil nen bil te simil nen taw bole pire, “Ibal kobe kobile aa tere na sinamua,” dire iru pirungwa, ena nusi erungwa ongwa yal kobe, Aposel, mone mone di awli ungwa.
Aposel kobe u ku bilungwa ibal mina mile kuril pirekire, ka di maribe erungwa
Awli ala ongure nusi erungwa ongwa yal kobe, Aposel, u ku bilungwa ibal guman mina ale milungwa. Milungure Yuda ka main kenin erungwa yal bil sirin bile tere iru dungwa,
“‘Yesu ka main nil si tekio,’ iru di i tobinba kano. Yerusalem ibal kobe para muru di tengire kaya piremua. Yesu gulungwa na pirin painama dire iru erinwa.”
Pita te Aposel kobe imo mile iru maan di tongwa, “God ka dungwa te ibal ka dungwa u kuunin ta pekenangwa, ena God ka dungwa kaya wiina erabinawa.
I Yesu eri pera bolimina bili nil sire si gulingire, gulungwa gul alungure, na ibal kobe sanamoi gilekume ibalin kobe, God Yesu ulin yuure iru ere yalini tomua.

Isirel ibal kobe kal digan ere taalime erungwa pisere nomanin suna si kiruul sire, pirin paangwa God kire di erama dire, God Yesu aa te yebe erungure inin aan wen kol mile, Singaba mile inin para aa ki di na tongwa yal milemua.
Kalin dungwa na yal kobe te God Kegemama Iban para kane bolin kule tobinwa. God ka dungwa mere ibal kobe pire wiina erungure, God yalini inin Kegemama Iban ibalin kobi tomua,” dungwa.
Gameliel mile yalin kobi imore milamua, dire di tongwa
Ka dungwa i u ku bilungwa yal kobe pirere den gule, “Nusi erungwa ongwa yal kobe, Aposel, si gulabinwa,” dire iru di pirungwa.
Pirimba Parasi yal ta i suna milungwa kaan Gameliel, ka main nil si tongwa ibal kobe nomanin wai pire tongure, yalini alere, “Aposel kobe awli mena po,” di tongwa.
Di tere iru di u ku bilungwa yal kobe tongwa, “Isirel nen kobe, kal ta ere yalin kobe tenanga, nomanin si pirekun ero.

Goma yal ta kaan Teudas u bawa dire, ‘Singaba bil miliwa,’ dungure yal kobe binanbile, po kandret, pi gawlima kobe kule milimba, ibal kobe yalini si gulungure gawlima kobe u sutaw ongure, yalini konagi erungwa wei simua.
Iru erungure pare Galili nen ta kaan Yudas, gabman kaan galungwa kaun u bawa dungure, ibal kobe binanbile duulin bile warimba para iru si gulungure pare, gawlima kobe para u sutaw omua.
Iru erungwa mere malia iru di teralga, kal ta yal kobe ere terala di piringa pisero. Imore milamua, Konagi erungwa yal kobe inin nomanin si pire erangwa yaa ime sinamba,
God konagi painangwa i yaa ime ta sekenanwa. Iru eranga ena i God kura bile tenga mere painamua,” dungwa.
Aposel kobe pire gi di Yesu tobinga giil pirebinwa, dire wai pirungwa

Yalini ka dungwa yal kobe pire wiina erere, “Nusi erungwa ongwa yal kobe, Aposel, ere wo,” di gala dungure, ungure kuba aa tere sire di yobilaan bile iru di tongwa, “Yesu guun kan kwi ama ibal kobe di tekio.” Dire kan gule erungure yal kobe ere ongwa.
Aposel kobe u ku bilungwa ai pisere wai pire iru dungwa, “Yesu pire gi dibinga giil pirebingire, goma God, ‘Para wai paimua,’ dungure u maribe omia wai pirebinwa.”
Yalin kobe kaun kaun ka main ogu bil ala te inin ogu ala, “Yesu God konagi erungwa yal, Kirisito milemua,” dire nil si tere kere di te milungwal milungwa.
